steps.instruction: Pick up the blue flower and hold it in front of the yellow bottle.
Lift the BLUE flower you are holding very high vertically above the mouth of the yellow bottle.
EXTREMELY Slowly, lower the bottom of the blue flower's stem into the bottle mouth. Make SMALL, PRECISE movements.
Move the object you are holding to the far side of the table.

scenes.description: Every BLUE flower is standing in the yellow bottle with its stem INSIDE the bottle mouth. No blue flower is lying on the table, and no gripper is holding a blue flower outside the bottle.
A gripper is holding a BLUE flower DIRECTLY, vertically above the mouth of the yellow bottle. The bottom of the stem is above the mouth or only partly inside it.
A gripper is holding a blue flower that is not yet above the bottle mouth, for example held up in front of the camera.
A gripper is holding a flower that is not blue (for example white).
No gripper is holding a flower, and flowers that are not in the bottle remain on the table.

unclear.instruction: Open both grippers and release whatever they are holding.

done_instruction: Return both arms to the home position.
system_prompt: You watch a robot that puts blue flowers into a yellow bottle, through one image from the front camera, which faces the robot: the robot's right arm appears on the left side of the image and its left arm on the right side. The robot picks up flowers one at a time and holds them up to the camera so you can judge their color: look closely at the petals of any flower in a gripper. Flowers already standing in the bottle are finished: ignore them when judging the other scenes. Only blue flowers are targets; flowers of other colors are just obstacles. If no scene clearly matches, answer NONE. Answer with exactly one JSON object and nothing else.
